description:
Problem: NASA's microgravity combustion data is massive and fragmented, complicating fire safety planning for deep space missions.
Idea: IgnisNode is a Super Intelligence (SI) dashboard that instantly retrieves, summarizes, and ranks these findings to deliver actionable fire-safety insights.
Build Plan: I will build a Serverless RAG architecture using a Python/FastAPI backend and an LLM API for context retrieval. The frontend will be a zero-dependency Vanilla JS application featuring.
